method.load_detection: MOV ES, word ptr [absolute CONST slot] and LES with an absolute pool operand in each MAPSYM member context packet
method.relocation_source: NE relocation chain sites in DGROUP segment 10 of assets/SIMANTW.EXE
method.symbol_attribution: each explicit ES:[expression] displacement is resolved against MAPSYM publics of the relocation target segment and the real extents returned by python tools/context.py --data PUBLIC --brief; a unique common public is named, otherwise UNRESOLVED
method.access_attribution: linear explicit ES: accesses after every selector load until the next instruction that writes ES (MOV ES, POP ES, or LES); every site retains bytes, function-local offset, and code-segment offset
method.confidence: HIGH means at least one inferred offset is an exact MAPSYM public start and every attributed access agrees; MEDIUM means a unique public is identified only by containment in its context extent; UNRESOLVED means no unique public is identified or accesses conflict
